text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-84721 — batch-prober (eu-west-1) reporting consecutive 5xx errors (5 failures within 4m). https://pagerduty.example/PD-84721

maya: acked on PagerDuty, taking initial triage. I'm oncall - will update.

maya: quick check — dashboards show prober failure rate jump at 12:07 UTC, all hosts in eu-west-1 returning 502/503 from runtime-gateway.

joel: are we seeing customer impact? any errors in frontend hits? (cc @anya)

anya: looking — some internal SLO traces show increased latency but only a handful of customer retries. Still, AcmeCorp has 3 failed calls in the last 5m. Not widespread yet.

sre-oncall: interesting, prober history shows a small rollback around 11:58 (deploy-1723). Could be related.

maya: copying logs from one prober node:
```
[12:06:38] request id=... status=502 host=runtime-gw-12 eu-west-1
error: upstream read timeout
stack: grpc: received unexpected EOS
```

joel: check the runtime pods' health in eu-west-1:
maya: running `kubectl -n runtime get pods -o wide --field-selector=spec.nodeName=gw-node-3` shows pod runtime-gw-12 in CrashLoopBackOff? it's restarting every ~30s.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: rollback of deploy-1723 requested by maya — queued.

maya: I'm going to put the canary prober into mute for eu-west-1 to stop noisy pages while we triage. Will mute PagerDuty rule for 10m.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD-84721 acknowledged by maya. Escalation paused.

maya: rolling back deploy-1723 now.

anya: after rollback started, error rate decreased in metrics within ~2m. runtime-gw-12 pod restarted and came back healthy at 12:11.

joel: nice. any long-term root cause hypothesis?

maya: initial theory: a jar change in deploy-1723 introduced a blocking path causing upstream timeouts under certain request headers. We'll collect traces and compare.

sre-oncall: I've exported the prober traces and attached to PD-84721 and SNOOZE ticket.

maya: handoff to oncall@team in 30m for post-rollback monitoring — @joel please take the 12:30-13:00 watch, I'll update the incident ticket with traces and start an RCA doc draft.

joel: taking handoff. I'll watch for 15m and then escalate to infra if anything reappears.

anya: customer impact note: AcmeCorp saw ~3 failed calls, reimbursable per SLA — flagged for support to contact.

maya: creating a quick mitigation checklist in the ticket: 1) rollback deploy 1723 (done) 2) mute noisy PagerDuty rule 3) collect traces/logs 4) add targeted probe to check header combinations 5) schedule RCA.

ops-bot: Mute applied to rule 'batch-prober-eu-west-1' for 10 minutes by maya.

joel: closing action — if no regression by 12:40 I'll mark resolved and file RCA. Updating PD to resolved in 15m if stable.

maya: thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD-84721: resolved by maya at 12:25 UTC (duration 18m). Postmortem assigned to maya/joel/anya.
